title: Your First Weekend at Gustavus Adolphus College, Shared as Cards
description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence for meeting your orientation circle, learning key campus landmarks, and making a careful first trip into Saint Peter.

cards.title: Friday Arrival: Find Your Gustie Greeter
cards.subtitle: Start with the student leader assigned to your orientation group.
cards.notes: Ask where your group meets, how schedule updates arrive, and which weekend questions are better handled by your faculty partner.
cards.short_summary: Make your assigned Greeter the first reference point for the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustie Greeters are upper-class student leaders who welcome new students, answer questions, and lead small Orientation Groups.
cards.access_notes: This stop applies during official New Student Orientation; follow the current schedule supplied to incoming students.

cards.title: Friday Afternoon: Meet Your Orientation Group
cards.subtitle: Learn a few names before the weekend schedule gets busy.
cards.notes: Introduce yourself, save the group’s next meeting point, and identify one person to contact if you become separated during activities.
cards.short_summary: Use the small-group session to establish a practical weekend contact circle.
cards.evidence_claim: Each new student is placed in a small Orientation Group led by a Gustie Greeter and a faculty partner.
cards.access_notes: The activity is for incoming students during Orientation; meeting details come from the current official schedule.

cards.title: Friday Afternoon: Set Old Main as a Landmark
cards.subtitle: Use the hilltop academic building to orient yourself on campus.
cards.notes: Pause outside to fix the building in memory, then note which direction leads back toward your residence hall and the campus center.
cards.short_summary: Anchor your mental map at Gustavus’s original Saint Peter building.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Main was the first Gustavus college building in Saint Peter and remains an active academic building housing several departments and the Chaplains’ Office.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is the dependable weekend option; the source does not establish unrestricted building access.

cards.title: Friday Evening: Read the Rock
cards.subtitle: See what message is currently displayed near Old Main.
cards.notes: Read the current message and take a photo if useful; only add paint after checking present campus expectations and coordinating supplies.
cards.short_summary: Encounter a changeable campus message board in physical form.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus documents painting the rock in front of Old Main with birthdays, campus events, student-organization messages, and congratulations.
cards.access_notes: The source documents the practice but supplies no formal schedule or participation protocol; follow current campus rules.

cards.title: Friday Evening: Learn the Market Place Setup
cards.subtitle: Practice navigating the main campus dining room before a busier weekday.
cards.notes: Locate the food stations, check displayed ingredients for your needs, and learn how your meal plan or à-la-carte payment works.
cards.short_summary: Use one meal to understand the main dining room’s layout and payment model.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus identifies the main dining room in Jackson Campus Center and states that Market Place dining is à la carte.
cards.access_notes: Check the linked current dining schedule before going; service changes during breaks and food requires payment or a meal plan.

cards.entity_name: Campus Activities Office Equipment and Board Game Rentals
cards.title: Saturday Morning: Plan a Low-Key Group Activity
cards.subtitle: Request a board, card, or yard game for a later gathering.
cards.notes: Choose an item your group can share, submit the request early, and wait for confirmation before building the evening around it.
cards.short_summary: Turn an unstructured weekend gap into a simple shared activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Activities Office rents yard games, board and card games, art supplies, bingo equipment, and other items through a request process.
cards.source_title: Campus Center and Student Union Reservations | Campus Activities
cards.access_notes: Requests are reviewed rather than guaranteed, typically within 72 hours, and reservable items are first come, first served.

cards.entity_name: The Arboretum at Gustavus Adolphus College trails
cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: Walk the Arboretum Trails
cards.subtitle: Follow a daylight route through the campus natural areas.
cards.notes: Pick a route at the entrance, keep enough daylight for the return, and treat the outing as a chance to learn the campus’s southwest edge.
cards.short_summary: Add an outdoor leg to the weekend without leaving campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is open to all during daylight hours, charges no admission, and has more than 2.5 miles of trails through three ecosystems.
cards.access_notes: Use the grounds only during daylight and adjust the route for weather, trail conditions, and posted guidance.

cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: Find the Borgeson Family Cabin
cards.subtitle: Give the Arboretum walk a clear visual destination.
cards.notes: Locate the cabin on the Arboretum map, view it from the grounds, and use the named landmark to confirm your return route.
cards.short_summary: Pair the trail walk with a documented piece of Swedish immigrant history.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus identifies the Borgeson Family Cabin as the former home of a Swedish immigrant family and an example of traditional construction.
cards.access_notes: The source supports locating and viewing the cabin but does not establish weekend entry to its interior.

cards.title: Sunday Morning: Walk Downtown Saint Peter
cards.subtitle: Learn the shape of the city center beyond campus.
cards.notes: Stay on public sidewalks, note useful civic landmarks, and treat building interiors as separate stops with their own access rules.
cards.short_summary: Use a bounded downtown walk to build an off-campus mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Saint Peter states that its entire downtown area is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
cards.access_notes: The historic designation supports an exterior district walk, not entry to private buildings; arrange suitable transportation.

cards.entity_name: Saint Peter Area Veterans Memorial at Minnesota Square Park
cards.title: Sunday Midday: End at Minnesota Square Park
cards.subtitle: Close the downtown loop at a named civic landmark.
cards.notes: Visit the memorial respectfully, use the park as a regrouping point, and confirm everyone’s return plan before leaving downtown.
cards.short_summary: Finish the first-weekend sequence with an easy-to-recognize city landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Saint Peter identifies Minnesota Square Park as the location of the Saint Peter Area Veterans Memorial.
cards.access_notes: Observe posted park rules and hours, and approach the memorial as a commemorative site rather than a recreation fixture.
